hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN KAZAKHSTAN
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Kazakhstan 2026–2027. Fast-growing medical destination with NMC compliant 5+1 year programs and affordable costs.

overview: Kazakhstan has become one of the most sought-after countries for Indian students pursuing MBBS abroad. Government and national universities offer 100% English-medium instruction, modern anatomy simulation theaters, and on-campus Indian messes with hostel facilities.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Kazakhstan valid in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees from NMC-recognized universities in Kazakhstan are fully valid in India upon passing the NExT/FMGE exam.

faq.question: What is the total fee for MBBS in Kazakhstan?
faq.answer: The complete package (tuition + hostel + Indian food) usually ranges from ₹18 lakh to ₹26 lakh for the full 6-year duration.
